requirement: Dispatch planning and execution are connected through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports only normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry. It does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so the execution operations, for example executeAuthorizedPlan at src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4, are not reachable through the public dispatch entry.

requirement: nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24) tests retryAfter for truthiness, so a server-provided retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff(attempt) instead of giving a 0 ms delay. Dispatch-policy rule 7 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:16) says that when the server provides a finite numeric retryAfter, the delay it gives replaces the computed backoff.

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4) evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) before unlessForbidden (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:6) checks the canPlanRoute result. dispatchRoute (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5) calls dispatch(route) unconditionally, so dispatch runs for an unauthorized caller before the rejection is returned.

requirement: stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:30) compares stop.driver only. Dispatch-policy rule 30 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:63) defines a stop's assigned driver as the reassignment driver when the stop has a reassignment, so a reassigned stop is matched by its original driver and missed by its new driver.

requirement: writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: chooseDeparture (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:5-6) returns the date moved to blackout end hour 5 (atUtcHour at src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:20) without checking the departure window. The window is hours 2 through 4 (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:1, 9), so the moved departure is outside it. Dispatch-policy rule 14 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:26) requires refusal in that case, but a departure at hour 3 returns a date at hour 5 instead of null.

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:14-17) emits only through the onStored callback that savePlan passes to store.write as onCommit (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). Whether that callback runs only after storage succeeds depends on the store.write commit timing, which is not defined in the staged content or in docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, so the requirement cannot be verified from the available contracts.

requirement: hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: The duplicate key at src/dispatch/queue.mjs:18 joins depotId and normalizeRouteKey(routeKey) with no separator. Different route identities can produce the same key, for example depotId 'A1' with routeKey 'B' and depotId 'A' with routeKey '1B' both give 'A1B', so the function reports a duplicate where dispatch-policy rules 19 and 20 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:37-38) require none.

requirement: parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: parseRetryCount (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4) uses Number(value) and Number.isInteger, so text that is not one or more base-10 digits is accepted: '' gives 0, ' 2' gives 2, '1e0' gives 1 and '0x1' gives 1. Dispatch-policy rule 22 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:43) makes text valid only when it is one or more base-10 digits.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:19) excludes only state 'delivered'. Dispatch-policy rule 31 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:64) defines a delivered stop as one whose state is 'delivered' or 'handedOver', so stops with state 'handedOver' are wrongly returned as pending.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: orderedDestinationGroups (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:42) passes the Map returned by groupByDestination (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:3-9) to orderManifestGroups. The comparator at src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:11 reads the destination property of each element, but spreading the Map yields [key, group] arrays whose destination is undefined. The comparator returns 0, so the groups keep insertion order rather than ascending lexical order.

requirement: routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: locateStops (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:34) keeps a stop unless its lookup result is exactly undefined. docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:3 says lookup resolves to the point of a known address but does not say what an unknown address resolves to or whether lookup rejects, so whether unknown stops are left out cannot be verified from the Adapter contract.

requirement: retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:3) returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0. A total equal to the limit gives remaining capacity 0, which fails the strict > 0 test, so a total equal to the configured limit is refused.

requirement: canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: canPlanRoute (src/dispatch/access.mjs:3) grants the ownership exception only when actor.scopes, the own scopes, includes routes:admin. Dispatch-policy rule 3 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:9) applies to held scopes, and rule 4 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:10) defines held scopes as own scopes plus the scopes of active claims. An actor holding routes:admin through an active claim therefore does not own every depot under this check.

requirement: canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5) drops own scopes for a suspended actor but keeps the scopes of active claims, and canPlanRoute (src/dispatch/access.mjs:3) checks actor.scopes for routes:admin without checking suspension. Dispatch-policy rule 5 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:11) says a suspended actor has no held scopes, so a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim and depot ownership, or with own routes:admin and an active routes:plan claim, can still plan a route.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Dispatch manifest publication is connected through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32) removes current, the value returned by store.get(manifest.id). docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6 says get resolves to a new copy of the stored manifest, and docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:7 says remove removes a stored manifest only when given that exact stored object. The copy is not the stored object, so remove deletes nothing and the stored manifest remains after announcement failure.

requirement: redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: stripCredentials (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14) recurses only into values whose constructor is Object. An array under auth, for example auth.sessions holding an object with a token field, is returned unchanged, so a credential nested in that array is kept. Dispatch-policy rule 24 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:48) requires credential removal at every depth.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: buildManifest copies each record with a spread (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:26), but labelDriver (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:34) runs Object.assign(driver, ...) on the driver object that is still shared with the supplied record. The supplied record's nested driver object is mutated, so the supplied records are not left unchanged.

requirement: publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: publishManifest maps entries with an async callback (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:5), so checks holds Promise objects. Promise objects are truthy, so checks.every(Boolean) (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:6) always passes and stageManifest (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:7) stores a manifest with invalid entries. The result of manifestEntryIsValid (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:22) is never awaited.

requirement: successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
departureMinute is a stop's arrivalMinute plus its service time.
publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: asPublicationError (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19) sets transient to true whenever retryAfter is finite, even when the error is marked transient: false. Dispatch-policy rule 27 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:54) says a failure marked transient: false is never transient. Rule 27 is later than rule 26 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:53), so it overrides rule 26 under the section rule at docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:3. retryTransient (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:10) then allows the retry.

requirement: preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters the trimmed IDs from normalizePackageIds (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:37, src/dispatch/normalize.mjs:11) against seen, but adds the raw untrimmed IDs to seen (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38). An ID with surrounding whitespace in an earlier group, for example ' P1', does not match 'P1' in a later group, so that duplicate is kept. The spec at .scratch/0001-dispatch-control/spec.md:21 requires package IDs to be trimmed before deduplication.

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
A route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop (dispatch-policy).
finding: routeDuration (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:32) adds travelMinutes and serviceMinutes only. Dispatch-policy rule 32 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:65) defines a stop's service time as serviceMinutes plus 5 minutes of parking, so the 5 parking minutes of each stop are omitted.

requirement: Manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data (dispatch-policy).
finding: stripCredentials (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14) recurses only into values whose constructor is Object. An array under auth, for example auth.sessions holding an object with a token field, is returned unchanged, so a credential nested in that array is kept. Dispatch-policy rule 24 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:48) requires credential removal at every depth.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation (storage-contract).
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32) removes current, the value returned by store.get(manifest.id). docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6 says get resolves to a new copy of the stored manifest, and docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:7 says remove removes a stored manifest only when given that exact stored object. The copy is not the stored object, so remove deletes nothing and the manifest written earlier remains after announcement failure.

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters the trimmed IDs from normalizePackageIds (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:37, src/dispatch/normalize.mjs:11) against seen, but adds the raw untrimmed IDs to seen (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:38). An ID with surrounding whitespace in an earlier destination group, for example ' P1', does not match 'P1' in a later group, so that duplicate is kept.

requirement: Atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails (storage-contract).
finding: writePlanAtomically (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:9) calls discardTemporary after renameTemporary rejects. docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:11 says the temporary bytes then stay in place and are locked, and docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:13 says discardTemporary only closes the write and keeps locked bytes. Deleting them requires removeTemporary (docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:14), which the function does not call.

requirement: publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored (storage-contract).
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit (dispatch-policy).
finding: canAssignAllPackages (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:14) delegates to withinVehicleCapacity (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:3), which refuses a total equal to the limit because remainingVehicleCapacity (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:12) returns 0 and the check is > 0.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs does not export ./executor.mjs, so none of the execution operations are exported by the public dispatch entry, for example executeAuthorizedPlan at src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4 and runEligibleStops at src/dispatch/executor.mjs:12.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: withSortedKeys (src/dispatch/serialize.mjs:1) wraps only the top-level plan object, so keys inside nested objects keep their insertion order in JSON.stringify called from serializePlan (src/dispatch/serialize.mjs:3). checksumPlan (src/dispatch/serialize.mjs:7) hashes those bytes, so plans that differ only in key order inside nested objects produce different hashes.

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency (dispatch-policy).
finding: The urgent filter uses priorityOf (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:22), which returns 5 for non-finite priorities, but the remaining filter tests the raw value !(stop.priority > 5) (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:23). A stop with priority Infinity or the string '10' is excluded from both partitions, although dispatch-policy rule 15 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:30) gives it priority 5 and it belongs in the remaining partition.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
The next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13 (dispatch-policy).
finding: nextDispatchTime (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:15) tests candidate.getHours(), which reads local time, but dispatch-policy rule 10 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:22) requires all departure hours to be UTC hours. The blackout check therefore depends on the process time zone rather than UTC.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: emitPlanCreated (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:14-17) emits only through the onStored callback that savePlan passes to store.write as onCommit (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). Whether that callback runs only after storage succeeds depends on the store.write commit timing, which is not defined in the staged content or in docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, so the requirement cannot be verified from the available contracts.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable (storage-contract).
toStableJson uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules (dispatch-policy).
finding: compareStops (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:6) applies the fallback Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER only to null or undefined sequence values, because of ??. A non-finite sequence such as NaN or a string stays in the subtraction, so the comparator returns NaN, which sort treats as equal. Dispatch-policy rule 18 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:33) requires a stop without a finite numeric sequence to follow every stop of equal priority that has one.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch returns firstRejected <= 0 (src/dispatch/access.mjs:9). When the first route fails depot ownership, findIndex returns 0 and the function returns true, so a batch whose first route fails is accepted. Only failures from the second position onward are rejected.

requirement: Package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give (dispatch-policy).
finding: weighPackages stores the value of scale.read(packageId) unchanged (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:20). docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:8 says scale.read resolves to the measured weight but does not state its unit, while dispatch-policy rule 28 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:58) requires package weights to be in grams. The unit cannot be verified from the staged content or the Adapter contract.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start and exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4) evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) before unlessForbidden (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:6) checks the canPlanRoute result. dispatchRoute (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5) calls dispatch(route) unconditionally, so dispatch runs for an unauthorized caller before the rejection is returned.

requirement: Successful and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
A driver's workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver (dispatch-policy).
Retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value (dispatch-policy).
finding: parseRetryCount (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4) uses Number(value) and Number.isInteger, so text that is not one or more base-10 digits is accepted: '' gives 0, ' 2' gives 2, '1e0' gives 1 and '0x1' gives 1. Dispatch-policy rule 22 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:43) makes text valid only when it is one or more base-10 digits.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
The delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops (dispatch-policy).
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give (dispatch-policy).
Publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient (dispatch-policy).
finding: publishWithRetry retries while retryTransient returns true (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:10, 14). asPublicationError (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19) makes an error transient whenever retryAfter is finite, even when it is marked transient: false. Dispatch-policy rule 27 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:54) says such a failure is never transient and overrides rule 26 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:53) under the section rule at docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:3, so the failure should stop immediately but is retried.

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
A suspended actor cannot plan any route (dispatch-policy).
finding: effectiveScopes (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5) drops own scopes for a suspended actor but keeps the scopes of active claims, and canPlanRoute (src/dispatch/access.mjs:3) checks actor.scopes for routes:admin without checking suspension. Dispatch-policy rule 5 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:11) says a suspended actor has no held scopes, so a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim and depot ownership, or with own routes:admin and an active routes:plan claim, can still plan a route.

requirement: Delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry (dispatch-policy).
finding: sendDeliveryNotices sends to entry.phone unchanged (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:31). Dispatch-policy rule 33 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:66) defines an entry's contact phone as its phone with every space and hyphen removed, so delivery notices are sent to the unnormalized phone value.

requirement: The next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter (dispatch-policy).
finding: nextRetryDelay (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24) tests retryAfter for truthiness, so a server-provided retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff(attempt) instead of giving a 0 ms delay. Dispatch-policy rule 7 (docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md:16) says that when the server provides a finite numeric retryAfter, the delay it gives replaces the computed backoff.
